stepsTitle: Settle your plan for three steps

steps.title: 1. Create options
steps.body: Enter meeting name and dates or times to compare.

steps.title: 2. Share link
steps.body: Send am to your friends, teammates or group.

steps.title: 3. Confirm plan
steps.body: Check the votes and confirm the time wey fit everybody.

faqs.title: How group fit find time for friends hangout or team meeting?
faqs.body: Create date and time options for Time2Gather, then share the link. Everybody go pick when dem free. Compare the results and confirm the plan. E free for friends, study groups and teams.

faqs.title: I fit create poll and join without registration or app installation?
faqs.body: Yes. Host and participants only need enter name; no registration or social login dey required. You fit create meeting and vote with your phone or computer browser.

faqs.title: We fit vote for only dates or for particular times too?
faqs.body: Yes. Use date poll to choose day, or time poll to collect the time slots wey people free. Choose the one wey match your plan when you dey create meeting.

faqs.title: How I fit share scheduling poll for group chat?
faqs.body: Copy the meeting link put for group chat, message or email. Participants go open am, enter name and choose when dem free. Dem fit also find the meeting with invitation code.

faqs.title: We fit vote for meeting place too?
faqs.body: Yes. Turn on location voting when you dey create the meeting and add options. Participants fit vote for places wey dem prefer and discuss plans for comments.

faqs.title: I fit change my answer or continue with another device?
faqs.body: Before dem confirm the plan, open the link again for the browser wey you first use to change your answer. If you change device or browser, or clear browser data, the service fit no recognise you as the same participant. The same name no go restore old answers or host permissions.

faqs.title: People for different time zones fit plan meeting together?
faqs.body: Time polls use the meeting time zone wey host choose. You fit view results for another time zone to compare schedules with people abroad. For date-only polls, the dates wey people choose no go change because of time zone.

faqs.title: I fit add the plan to my calendar?
faqs.body: Yes. Download selected time or confirmed meeting from results as ICS file, then import am into calendar app wey support ICS. You no need connect calendar before you fit use polls.
